high_level_description: The image depicts the back of a black T-shirt featuring an artistic illustration of a cat dressed in traditional Japanese attire. The cat is wearing a kimono adorned with a floral pattern, primarily in shades of blue and white, with some red accents. The kimono has a sash tied around the waist, which is also decorated with floral designs. The cat itself has a surprised or startled expression, with wide eyes and an open mouth, giving it a humorous and lively appearance.
